rule: The last column holds a top-down legend of n colours, and each colour also appears once as a polyomino. The output is a (3(n+1)-1)-square table of 2x2 blocks with 1-cell gaps. Legend colours are the headers on the top row and left column, and the corner and diagonal blocks stay empty. Block (i,j) is 2 if shapes i and j are congruent under rotation/reflection, otherwise 5.
scope: Produce a legend-ordered comparison table for shapes equivalent under rotation or reflection, with equal-area near-miss classes.
constraints: Read source against saved mechanism, executable rule and all canonical pairs.
Expanded random masks to 5..20 cells and added an exact 5..25-cell control; explicit masks now require connectivity, tight crops, placement separation and valid palette.
120 independent 30x30 scenes each had seven shapes with exactly three or six classes.
840 shapes of 20/25 cells produced 2096 equal-area unequal pairs and 219 pairs requiring reflection; independent NumPy orbit comparisons reconstructed every table.
known_limitations: Background zero; legend starts at row zero of the last column; output blocks remain 2x2 with one-cell gaps.
Default shape classes span 2..n-1 and random legend counts are 3..7, so both equal and unequal marks appear.
Random shapes are connected polyominoes with bounded boxes; no overlapping objects or interleaved legend.
Larger masks and exact-area controls are synthetic extensions; placement remains bounded.

authored_scope: Supported: 3..7 legend colours from {1,3,4,6,7,8,9} in random order. Shapes are random 4-connected polyominoes of 5..11 cells, with bounding boxes up to about 5x7 (near-miss mutations up to 7x7). There are 2..n-1 congruence classes, so both marks always appear. Class members are random rotations/reflections. Distractor classes either share a cell count or are one-cell near-miss mutations. Input sizes are sampled up to 30x30. Explicit latent scenes (width, height, legend, shapes) reconstruct all fixtures. Deliberately not supported: background other than 0; legends not starting at row 0 or not in the last column; touching or overlapping shapes; n<3 (single-mark tables); n>7 (the palette is exhausted).
authored_constraints: Background is 0; colours 2 and 5 never appear in the input.
Legend colours are distinct and occupy rows 0..n-1 of the last column; height >= n.
Each legend colour forms exactly one 4-connected shape; shape bounding boxes have at least a 1-cell gap, so there is no diagonal contact.
Shapes stay in columns 0..width-3, so the legend column and the column beside it are free of shape cells.
Random scenes have between 2 and n-1 congruence classes, so at least one 2-pair and one 5-pair exist.
Distinct classes have distinct canonical forms under the 8 dihedral transforms.
